newsitem.title: USA: Comanche Energy Inc. announces purchase.
newsitem.headline: Comanche Energy Inc. announces purchase.

text.p: Comanche Energy Inc said Wednesday it purchased a 100 percent working interest, 75 percent net revenue interest in two gas wells in the Winter Garden Field, located in Dimmit County, Texas.

The company says estimated recoverable natural gas reserves are more than 3 billion cubic feet net to its interest. In addition to the producing Georgetown Formation, several additional productive oil zones will be completed at a later date.

Engineers are currently designing a gas treatment system to remove the sulfur. When complete in late October, the wells are expected to begin production at 600,000 cubic feet daily. This means additional monthly revenues of about $25,000 for the company, it said.
After producing the wells for several months, Comanche said, "the company expects to fracture treat the wells, which could significantly increase production rates and revenues."
The company also has an option to purchase an additional 20 oil wells on an adjacent property.
"We expect to exercise this option, subject to satisfactory title opinions within the next 120 days. These wells would measurably increase proved recoverable reserves."
